stories.title: Flintshire councillors demand pause to Catholic school closure plan after council’s “damning” Estyn report
stories.summary: Flintshire Liberal Democrats have called for the plan to close four Catholic schools to be paused, after describing Monday’s Estyn report on the council’s education services as damning. stories.title: North Wales Police puts domestic abuse specialist in its 999 control room
stories.summary: A domestic abuse specialist has been placed inside the control room where North Wales Police answers 999 and 101 calls. The force announced the appointment on Monday 24 August. stories.title: Cheshire Constabulary investigating suspected arson at Chester’s ancient Minerva Shrine
stories.summary: Police are appealing for witnesses after a fire was deliberately set at the Minerva Shrine, the Roman carving in Edgar’s Field, Handbridge. stories.title: Police appeal after counterfeit notes used at Holland & Barrett in Mold
